name: CLR
method_summary: Context Likelihood of Relatedness infers a symmetric weighted gene-gene network by comparing each mutual-information score against the empirical background distributions of both genes. In this integration, mutual information is computed with minet::build.mim and then minet::clr is applied so the wrapper preserves the method's raw CLR scores in network.csv.

progress.note: minet/CLR exposes no native callbacks or incremental counters for MIM construction or CLR scoring; the wrapper can only report coarse lifecycle states.

estimator.description: Mutual-information estimator used by minet before running CLR. Correlation-based estimators are suitable for continuous expression data; discrete MI estimators are also available.

disc.description: Discretization strategy used when the selected estimator requires discretized inputs.

nbins.description: Optional number of bins for discretization. Use null to follow the upstream default sqrt(NROW(dataset)).

oneOf.description: Use null to preserve the upstream default sqrt(NROW(dataset)).
